Jules (People Ops): Quick Q — need help slotting a rapid promo for someone switching from IC to EM mid-cycle. New role effective 4/10, manager submitted evidence today. How do we handle slotting + ongoing bonus proration for the current cycle? :thinking:
Maya (Manager): Congrats! They accepted. Question: do we slot to next level immediately or backdate to 4/10? Hiring packet says promos are effective on first of pay period but exceptions exist.
Sam (People Ops): Hi Jules — we can do off-cycle promos. Two decisions: 1) slot level (title/band) effective date; 2) comp change effective date for payroll. For off-cycle we usually set title effective date = manager requested date, comp effective date = first pay period after approvals. That avoids retro payroll unless approved for backpay.
Jules (People Ops): Ok. What about bonus proration? They already received Q1 pro-rated sign-on. This is for annual bonus target change.
Alex (Payroll): For bonuses: if comp change crosses payout period, we prorate target for time at each target. We'll need the official comp_change form + approved salary. Payroll cutoff for next cycle is 4/20. If you need back-pay we need approval and justification.
Maya (Manager): And for someone remote in EMEA, any currency/contract nuances? cc @Lina-Finance
Lina-Finance: EMEA: payout currency follows local payroll entity. If promo changes band that impacts localization rates — we need local HR to confirm tax implications. Expect extra 5-7 business days to process.
Sam (People Ops): TL;DR checklist:
```
- Manager submits evidence + comp recommendation
- People Ops approves band slotting
- Compensation approves salary change
- Manager signs off on effective dates
- Payroll receives comp_change form by cutoff
- Finance/local HR confirms tax/currency
```
Maya (Manager): If manager wants retroactive salary to 4/10, what's required?
Sam (People Ops): Retro requires manager + director signoff and rationale (gap-to-market, retention). Also People Ops lead approval. Retro pay requires payroll ticket and may trigger manual adjustments.
Jules (People Ops): What about equity/grants? This is time-sensitive.
Sam (People Ops): Equity changes are handled by Rewards team. For off-cycle grants, we need approvals and a grant agreement. Timeline often 2-3 weeks.
hr-bot: Reminder: use /promo-request template in Confluence: https://redwood-internal/confluence/promo-template :link: 
Maya (Manager): Thanks — I'll start the forms. One last: does this change candidate's probation/manager review schedule? They were 90-day after hire.
Sam (People Ops): Probation remains tied to hire date unless manager requests reset. Note in request if you want probation reset.
Alex (Payroll): I'll flag payroll for a possible retro run if forms come in before 4/20.
Maya (Manager): Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
Jules (People Ops): Appreciate the quick answers — will attach docs now.
